writeup: Mikasa Gourmet Basics' freezable cooling charcuterie tray (MPN 5318169, UPC 025398238484) is a 12.75-inch aluminum marble cooling surface on a pine wood base. Freeze it for two hours, then it stays cold for about two hours of serving. Woot has it for $34.99. Mikasa and Pfaltzgraff both list the same Lifetime Brands tray in stock at $84.99, which makes this price 58 percent below the current brand retail, or $50 less.
